2609.26381.title: Layout-Guided Masking for GROBID: Lightweight Structural Gains in Large-Scale Scientific PDF Ingestion
2609.26381.paper_summary: Transforming scholarly PDFs into machine-readable fulltext remains a bottleneck for large-scale information systems. Recent vision-based parsers improve accuracy, but need GPUs and may introduce noise into the extracted text. GROBID, a modular font-stream parser running on CPU, is the de-facto standard for structuring scientific articles and underpins several of the largest open scholarly corpora. We pair it with a lightweight CPU detector localising figure, table, and paratext (header, footer, page number) regions, encoded as typed-area masks whose tokens are routed to GROBID's specialised models or discarded. On two PMC corpora, Bioinformatics (1,926 articles) and Materials Science (2,595), scored against JATS with a section-aware structural protocol, our extension improves over plain GROBID on most metrics (NS $+0.025$/$+0.013$; $+0.086$ paragraph recall on Materials Science, $d_z{=}1.08$), and caption-linked figure recovery improves on both corpora. On the external Table-BRGM benchmark, table detection recovers F1 $0.16 \to 0.94$ and table structure follows (GriTS-Top $0.27 \to 0.78$, below the strongest GPU system). On body text, against four vision-based systems (Docling, MinerU, olmOCR, dots.ocr), it has the best paragraph precision on both corpora, the best section detection on Materials Science, and a character error rate within 0.004 of the best GPU parser. End-to-end on CPU, it costs $2.7$--$3.2\times$ less than the cheapest GPU system (Docling) and $10$--$14\times$ less than generative parsers.
2609.26381.paper_summary_zh: 將學術PDF轉換為機器可讀的全文仍然是大規模信息系統的瓶頸。最近基於視覺的解析器提高了準確性，但需要GPU，並可能在提取的文本中引入噪音。GROBID，一個運行在CPU上的模組化字型流解析器，是結構化科學文章的事實標準，並支撐著幾個最大的開放學術語料庫。我們將其與輕量級的CPU檢測器配對，該檢測器定位圖形、表格和附加文本（標題、頁腳、頁碼）區域，這些區域編碼為類型區域掩碼，其標記被路由到GROBID的專用模型或被丟棄。在兩個PMC語料庫上，生物信息學（1,926篇文章）和材料科學（2,595篇），根據具有區段感知結構協議的JATS進行評分，我們的擴展在大多數指標上優於普通GROBID（NS $+0.025$/$+0.013$；材料科學的段落召回率為$+0.086$，$d_z{=}1.08$），並且與標題相關的圖形恢復在兩個語料庫上都有所改善。在外部Table-BRGM基準上，表格檢測恢復F1 $0.16 \to 0.94$，表格結構隨之而來（GriTS-Top $0.27 \to 0.78$，低於最強的GPU系統）。在正文文本中，與四個基於視覺的系統（Docling、MinerU、olmOCR、dots.ocr）相比，它在兩個語料庫上具有最佳的段落精確度，在材料科學上具有最佳的區段檢測，並且字符錯誤率在最佳GPU解析器的0.004內。端到端在CPU上，其成本比最便宜的GPU系統（Docling）低$2.7$--$3.2\times$，比生成解析器低$10$--$14\times$。
